{{Infobox auto|title=Prayer of Glaucus|type=[[Blessing]]}}
The '''Prayer of Glaucus''' is a [[blessing]], a crafted enchanted book that stores {{MCW|Luck of the Sea}} III, {{MCW|Lure}} III and {{MCW|Loyalty}} I. It is crafted from three nautilus shells and an azure bluet.

== Obtaining ==
=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The book in the center must be a [[Hell-Bound Book]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/lure_luck_of_the_sea.json}}</ref> The crafted item is named "Blessing", with "Prayer of Glaucus" as a dark gray lore line.

== Usage ==
The Prayer of Glaucus is applied to equipment in an [[anvil]], like an {{MCW|Enchanted Book|enchanted book}}. Luck of the Sea and Lure apply to [[Fishing Rod|fishing rods]] at their vanilla maximum of III; Loyalty applies to tridents. See [[Fishing]] for how the pack's fishing uses luck.

== Trivia ==
* Glaucus is a fisherman of Greek myth who became a sea god, suiting the fishing enchantments.
